name: word
title: Mind's word
owns: The single decision intake: held questions, exact answers and completion receipts. It keeps no store of its own and persists through the Pool: it mints the question, decision-round and card identities, validates every answer against the records as they stand, and makes exactly one hive-pool mutation per operation under its own request identity, so replay is the Pool's. It writes no record, receipt or event itself.

commands.name: hive-word
commands.purpose: Holds, revisions, exact answers, completion and verification of the Mind's word.

test_scope: Complete rounds, authorized answers, deduplication and unresolved holds. From stage 2: an option qualified by free text kept as one answer; free text alone as a complete answer; Later recorded as a deferral and never an approval; a stale card refused; an answer to a changed question held for reconciliation; a worker's answer refused; a review submission verified against its round file; one submission answering two cards of one round, each deduplicated by its own question; a second answer to an answered question refused unless it supersedes; a revised question with a late answer against the old revision recorded unreconciled; an answer with no option, deferral or text invalid; replay verified by the digest of the original request; verification that reads the record and never the reference.
